d:
This gallery includes everything a physical XBOX360 Limited Edition copy comes with for the remastered version of the game Phantom of Inferno, released only in Japan back in 2012.
#1. External box art
#2. CD case cover art, booklet and a CD disc containing several Original Soundtracks
#3. Cover art of the XBOX360 box, it's manual and XBOX360 disc containing the game.
#4. "Memories of Phantom" extra artbook

OP NOTE: You will probably notice that the resolutions of several images are quite different (smaller/bigger) and just like with other galleries like this that I've posted, the reason is the site's file size limit and I've had to downscale a few images to fit the limits.
n: [Non-H] Phantom of Inferno [XBOX360 - Limited Edition] Box Art, Booklet + "Memories of Phantom" Artbook
